description:
Problem (Advisor B1, B6, D phase 3): pin bumps are manual, unevidenced and reviewed only by the old build; each bump re-opens a trust-on-first-use window on the build host (no published checksums), times three platforms.

Outcome (owner decision: every release, Mac evidence before merge): a scheduled job detects a new omp release, downloads each platform build twice over TLS and compares hashes, runs the candidate compatibility suite on linux-x64, and opens a bump PR that edits only the pin section and captured fixtures, with the suite output, per-platform hashes and --version transcripts, and the --help diff against the previous build. The PR body states that the suite carries the behavioural evidence and the old-build oracle reviews the YAML. The owner runs `make omp-candidate-check` on the Mac and posts the result before the PR merges; pr-arm refuses a bump PR without that evidence. Suite red: no PR, the old pin stands. docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md 'Changing the reviewer harness' covers pin bumps and drops the real-model re-record step.

Decision gates:
1. Ask the owner via the choice dialog to ratify that the compatibility suite replaces old-build oracle judgment for bump PRs and that the doc change drops the real-model re-record step (Advisor E7).
2. No mirror (owner decision): if a pinned build disappears from the build host, the revert path cannot install the old build; record this risk in the docs.

Item guardrails: a bump PR touches only the pin section and fixtures; never a version range; gateway and reviewer pins change together.

FREEZE LIFTED (owner 2026-10-27): the oracle-code merge freeze is removed; PRs merge on the normal rules (oracle SHIP on the exact head, threads answered and resolved, make pr-arm).

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it.
